description: Three amendments: one with no date withdraws SMOKE ("withdrawn"); one effective 2027-01-01, after the profile's asOf 2026-10-04, would withdraw ESCAPE but does not apply yet, so ESCAPE is evaluated; and one withdraws a rule the pack does not have and a rule of a pack that is not given - FS-RULES-011 for each. An amendment that does not apply is not checked.
